short_cite: Satomi & Kruger 1982 (SGP-TR-63)
full_citation: Satomi, K. and Kruger, P. (1982). Radon Emanation Mechanism from Finely Ground Rocks. Stanford Geothermal Program Report SGP-TR-63.
notes: CORRECTS NOTE ON EXISTING ROW S0505. Re-read 2026-10-27 via fetch tool: p.6 states only that Semprini found average radon in the liquid-dominated reservoirs of Cerro Prieto and Wairakei 40 times lower than in the vapour-dominated Geysers reservoir; no unit or basis is given, and Semprini attributes it to pore-fluid density (steam vs water). Saturated-vapour/liquid density ratio at 240-250 C is about 40-50 (steam tables, my arithmetic), so the 40x is most plausibly per unit reservoir volume, not per kg steam or per GW a. See papers_round2_geothermal.md section 4.
